<script setup lang="ts">
import { StepperRoot, type StepperRootEmits, type StepperRootProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<StepperRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<StepperRootEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * `StepperItem` elements. Receives the active step.
   */
  default?: (props: { modelValue?: number }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <StepperRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="stepper"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    :class="cn('flex gap-2', $attrs.class ?? '')"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </StepperRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { StepperDescription, type StepperDescriptionProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<StepperDescriptionProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Short explanation of the step.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <StepperDescription
    data-slot="stepper-description"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    :class="cn('text-xs text-muted-foreground', $attrs.class ?? '')"
  >
    <slot />
  </StepperDescription>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { StepperIndicator, type StepperIndicatorProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<StepperIndicatorProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Step number or icon. Receives the current step index.
   */
  default?: (props: { step: number }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <StepperIndicator
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="stepper-indicator"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    :class="cn(
      'inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground/50',
      'group-data-[disabled]:opacity-50',
      'group-data-[state=active]:bg-primary group-data-[state=active]:text-primary-foreground',
      'group-data-[state=completed]:bg-secondary group-data-[state=completed]:text-secondary-foreground',
      $attrs.class ?? '',
    )"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </StepperIndicator>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { StepperItem, type StepperItemProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<StepperItemProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Trigger, indicator, title, and separator. Receives the step state.
   */
  default?: (props: { state: 'completed' | 'active' | 'inactive' }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <StepperItem
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="stepper-item"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    :class="cn('group flex items-center gap-2 data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none', $attrs.class ?? '')"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </StepperItem>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { StepperSeparator, type StepperSeparatorProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<StepperSeparatorProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <StepperSeparator
    data-slot="stepper-separator"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    :class="cn(
      'bg-muted group-data-[disabled]:opacity-50 data-[state=completed]:bg-secondary',
      'data-[orientation=horizontal]:h-px data-[orientation=horizontal]:flex-1',
      'data-[orientation=vertical]:w-px data-[orientation=vertical]:flex-1',
      $attrs.class ?? '',
    )"
  />
</template>
